exploit_name: Service owner steals protocol tokens via reentrancy in create
description: ServiceManager.create() calls ServiceRegistry.create() (which may invoke onERC721Received callbacks) before completing the token-utility interaction via createWithToken(). No reentrancy guard or state update protects the operation.
attack_scenario: Malicious service creator receives NFT callback, reenters to modify bond parameters via update(), then activates registrations at the reduced bond. When the outer execution resumes, createWithToken() uses the original (higher) bond configuration, allowing the attacker to claim excess funds.
root_cause: ServiceManager.create() calls ServiceRegistry.create() (which may invoke onERC721Received callbacks) before completing the token-utility interaction via createWithToken(). No reentrancy guard or state update protects the operation.
fix_description: Derive the expected service ID in advance and call createWithToken() before ServiceRegistry.create(). Add reentrancy guards.
notes: Direct drainage of token-utility contract funds.
